  {"step":2,"file":"sapi/fuzzer/fuzzer-mbstring.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"args[0]","code":"args[0] = data; args[1] = data; fuzzer_call_php_func(\"mb_ereg\", 2, args);","note":"The crafted pattern is passed into mb_ereg as both pattern and subject, forcing Oniguruma to parse and optimize the attacker-controlled regex.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"value"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"optimize_nodes","line":6251,"var":"node","code":"static int optimize_nodes(Node* node, OptNode* opt, OptEnv* env)","note":"Regex compilation recursively walks the parsed AST to compute optimization metadata; the crash state shows repeated optimize_nodes frames, so the bug is in this recursive analysis path.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"control","via":"function call"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"optimize_nodes","line":6485,"var":"en->opt_count","code":"case NODE_BAG: ... case BAG_MEMORY: en->opt_count++; if (en->opt_count > MAX_NODE_OPT_INFO_REF_COUNT) ... else { r = optimize_nodes(NODE_BODY(node), opt, env); }","note":"Memory-group nodes are revisited during optimization; the node-local opt_count is used to limit recursion and steer whether the body is reprocessed or summarized.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"AST traversal"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regparse.c","function":"node_new_bag","line":2492,"var":"BAG_(node)->opt_count","code":"BAG_(node)->opt_count = 0;","note":"Each memory-group node starts with a zeroed optimization counter, so repeated visits during a single compilation mutate this shared field in place.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"field update"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"optimize_nodes","line":6490,"var":"en->opt_count","code":"en->opt_count++; if (en->opt_count > MAX_NODE_OPT_INFO_REF_COUNT) { ... }","note":"The same BAG_MEMORY node is incremented again on recursive re-entry; because the node is shared across the traversal, this stateful counter can be driven past the intended limit and the optimizer continues with stale node state, leading to the use-after-free observed in the crash state.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"shared mutable node state"}]}]
p.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
